x: His all-out burst then devastated the field when they were least expecting it and as he raced away only Clive Thomas (TVH) could hold him. As expected, Thomas re-passed him in the home straight but John came home a clear second, beating several others who might have laid claim to the silver medal.
John Stow did everything right but for the second successive year trailed Thames Valley's Clive Thomas home, unable to match his finishing burst over the last 150 metres.
